<h2 class="case-study-title">Looking beyond the brand.</h2>

<p>
For this group project, we analyzed employee satisfaction and workplace practices at Amazon to better understand the relationship between organizational practices and the employee experience.
</p>

<p>
Our team combined research and analysis to identify key findings and develop recommendations based on the issues we examined.
</p>

<p>
The project included both a written report and a presentation communicating our research, findings, and recommendations.
</p>
